evidence: A color sample is only useful here if it’s on the specified material. / The grey one is right, but it isn’t the color the customer chose.

options.whyZh: 灰色樣片已到貨，沒有到得太晚的說法。

options.text: Grey is not the color selected by the customer.
options.zh: 灰色不是客戶選的顏色。
